title: Suspension, Lapse and the Ending of Keyturn Host Protection Plan Cover
content:
The standing of an enrolment on the Keyturn Host Protection Plan moves between cover in force, cover paused, cover fallen away and cover ended, and each movement has its own ground.

### Suspension

Cover is suspended, never quietly ignored, where an inspection falls overdue, a required document expires, a host liability goes unpaid, a fraud review opens or the host asks for it, and the ground is recorded on the enrolment so that the host is told what must be put right. The ground stands on the enrolment record itself, alongside the standing of the enrolment, which at the moment of suspension is either cover in force or cover already paused. A suspension pauses cover for trips beginning while it stands, but never withdraws cover from a trip already running when it began.

### Lapse

Cover falls away where a host liability stays unpaid past the plan's lapse period, counted in whole calendar days from the day the liability was raised, and a lapse is not a cancellation, since a lapsed enrolment may be reinstated while a cancelled one may not.

### Restoration after a lapse

> Retired clause: "A lapsed enrolment may be reinstated inside the plan's reinstatement window on payment of the plan's reinstatement fee." This clause is no longer in force and is not applied to any enrolment.

What remains of that provision governs the effect of a restoration: cover begins again on the day of reinstatement and not retrospectively, and nothing that happened while the enrolment was lapsed becomes covered.

### Ending cover

A host may end cover on their own vehicle at any time on the plan's notice, but never before the plan's minimum enrolment period has run, and ending cover is the host's own act rather than something the marketplace does on their behalf. Where a claim is open the enrolment may be suspended but not ended, because the claim is settled under the enrolment it was made on; whether a claim stands open is read, before the enrolment is ended, from the claim records standing against that same enrolment.

### Condition and result

| Standing | What it means |
|---|---|
| Cover paused | Trips beginning during the pause are not covered; a trip already running when it began stays covered. |
| Cover fallen away | Cover may be restored; what happened during the lapse stays uncovered. |
| Cover ended by the host | Nothing further is settled under the enrolment and it cannot be restored. |

superseded_clauses: A lapsed enrolment may be reinstated inside the plan's reinstatement window on payment of the plan's reinstatement fee
